noise_policy.action: Preserve every round; flag noise or regression for investigation. This R2 baseline is not an R5 performance pass.

measurement_definitions.standalone: Existing capture test calls the production decoded Raw Input dispatch and queue path with controlled records. Excludes GetRawInputData, hardware arrival, IPC, and app ingestion.
measurement_definitions.integrated: Release worker replay through the production named pipes, receiver, and session owner, using only the public Backend API.
measurement_definitions.all_committed_ns: From immediately before Start to the first public status observation of the exact complete record count. Includes replay scheduling, IPC, ingestion, status publication, and observer polling.
measurement_definitions.command_ack_ns: Wall time around the public Backend execute call. This is software control acknowledgment time, not input or hardware latency.
measurement_definitions.progress: Public status observations, not per-record enqueue/send/commit timestamps. Captured and sent counters may be from an older status frame.
measurement_definitions.throughput: Complete records divided by observed all-committed wall time. Paced replay throughput, not maximum capture throughput.
measurement_definitions.wire_record_payload_bytes: Exact fixed-record payload from record count times runtime wire width. Excludes frame headers and does not claim to count memory copies.
measurement_definitions.percentiles: Nearest-rank percentiles across the five measured trials, not per-packet latency percentiles. P95, P99, and P99.9 may coincide with the maximum.
measurement_definitions.observer_comparison: Sampled 1 ms and minimal 10 ms observers use identical transport and input. Their timing differences expose observer sensitivity, not exact observer overhead.
measurement_definitions.budgets: Read current runtime constants/configuration and observed reservations; fixture contains no duplicate resource budget.
measurement_definitions.raw_input_smoke: A real registered Raw Input window reports enumeration and observed actual packets separately. Zero packets is valid initialization evidence, not high-rate hardware verification.
